summary: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe around lower-tier defense and aerospace suppliers. The best fit for this pass is not the mega-cap prime contractors themselves, but publicly listed tier-2/tier-3 electronics, structures, composites, and test-system suppliers whose qualified positions may become more valuable if DoD and primes push spending, reshoring, supply-chain illumination, and capacity funding deeper into the industrial base.
